skills.name: Introduction (序)
skills.line: The show is about to begin.
skills.description: Kinnara strums her lute to play the prelude and attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: This attack also inflicts the effect of her last played Tune.

skills.name: Raided (破)
skills.line: In this endless night, I form my melodies into light.
skills.description: At the start of Kinnara's turn, 1 of random 5 Tunes will be available to her. Their related effects are triggered when she plays a Tune. ; :

upgrades.text: After playing a Tune her, move bar is increased by 35%.
At the start of every round, she gains 50% of damage reduction from crit damage. Each time after playing a Tune, 10% of the damage reduction will be converted into 20% of Crit DMG.
After playing a Tune, she gains Shelter (lasts for 1 turn).

skills.name: Do: Crimson Dusk (宮・赤之霞/宮・赤の霞)
skills.description: Kinnara attacks an enemy dealing damage equal to 150% of her ATK and has a 100% base chance of inflicting Isolation on them, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Re: Royalty Orange (商・山吹)
skills.description: Kinnara launches a 5-strike attack on random enemies, dealing damage equal to 90% of her ATK with each strike. This attack will not trigger enemy souls.

skills.name: Mi: Glowing Shrine (角・神宫华辉/角・神宮華輝)
skills.description: Kinnara increases the move bar of all allies by 10% and their Crit DMG by 40%, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: So: Gentle Breeze (徴・薫風)
skills.description: Kinnara restores the HP for all allies by 80% of her ATK and increases their DEF by 40%, lasts 2 turns.

skills.name: La: Purity (羽・澈)
skills.description: Kinnara grants 1 onibi and dispels 1 debuff or control effect from all allies. If no more than 3 debuffs or control effects are dispelled, 1 additional onibi is granted.

skills.name: Conclusion (急)
skills.line: Thank you all for playing this number with me.
skills.description: Kinnara plays Tune of Itsukushima to attack an enemy with music notes 5 times, dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK with each music note.

upgrades.text: This attack also inflicts the effects of her played Tunes.

bio.condition: In Duel, Practice or Spar, use Conclusion with all 5 Tune effects and win.
